applies_to: TSI PresSura RPM20 room pressure monitors for one room, a room with anteroom, or two rooms with an anteroom.
summary: The RPM20 monitors up to two rooms and an anteroom, plus room temperature, humidity, supply and exhaust flow and air changes per hour. Over BACnet MS/TP it exposes the readings, per-room alarm limits and modes, and the Status Index alarm code. Supply flow, exhaust flow, humidity and room temperature can be written in over BACnet.
notes: From the RPM20 PresSura Monitor table in the BACnet MS/TP Object Set appendix (manual pages 104-109).
Access follows the Writable Value column; rows marked only in the Writable Object column have a writable object name and are shown here as read-only values.
Units shown are the English set; the table lists the metric alternatives (Pa, l/s, m³/hr, °C).
Anteroom and Room 2 objects only apply when Number of Rooms (MV 1) is set to a matching configuration.

source.title: PresSura Room Pressure Monitor Models RPM10 and RPM20 Operation and Service Manual

integration.summary: Read room pressure, the flows and the Status Index (MV 16) for alarms; door and occupancy inputs are BIs. The room mode (positive, negative, no isolation) is writable from the BMS. The monitor can also take some readings from the BMS instead of wired sensors.
integration.remote_sensors: Supply flow, exhaust flow, relative humidity and room temperature can come from the BMS: enable BV 9 / BV 12 / BV 10 / BV 11 and write AV 55 / AV 58 / AV 56 / AV 57.
setup: Set Comm Type to BACnet in the Interface menu (Modbus is the default); Address (1-127) is the MS/TP MAC and MAC ID is the BACnet device ID.
BACnet MS/TP baud: 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800 or AutoBaud. Address, MAC ID and baud changes can take up to 1 minute to apply.
The BACnet MS/TP bus lands on terminals 34 (B), 35 (A) and 36 (Ref) of the digital interface module.
gotchas: Engineering units follow Units Value (MV 18): 1 = in. W.C./cfm (default), 2 = Pa/lps, 3 = Pa/m³/hr.
Room label AIs (AI 10 and up) carry the room name in their object name, not a value.
Alarm limits, delays, address and MAC ID are writable settings; do not write them cyclically.
